title: Working from Home for the First Time
paragraphs: When his company moved to remote work, Salim first worked from his bed. After one week, he saw that this made it hard to focus.
He bought a simple desk and a comfortable chair. He also told his family when he needed quiet time for work.
Video calls took practice. Once, Salim forgot to mute his microphone while his family discussed lunch nearby.
After a month, his home office felt more professional. He learned that good habits mattered as much as the technology.
